name: Accurate Critical (Combat, Critical)
body:
Your critical hits set you up to make even more accurate attacks.

Prerequisite: Critical Focus, BAB +9

Benefit: When you score a critical hit with a melee attack, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus on all your melee attack rolls until the end of your next turn. If your base attack bonus is +16 or higher, the circumstance bonus increases to +2.

Special: You can apply the effects of only one critical feat to a given critical hit unless you possess Critical Mastery.
